sections.Profile:
Hot Line and Big Strike , both produced by Williams in 1966, are electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Steve Kordek. Hot Line is the replay version, while Big Strike is the add-a-ball variant.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Fishing, Boats, Single Player, Hobbies, Sports, Fish, Original Theme, Water
